# Abdur Rehman Afzal

> AI Engineer & Full-Stack Python Developer based in Lahore, Pakistan, with 7+ years of experience shipping production systems across 9 live domains. Specializes in production RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines, LLM-powered automation, AI agents, and computer vision, on top of a strong backend foundation in Django, FastAPI, and cloud infrastructure.

This site (https://abdurrehmanafzal.cloud/) is itself a working RAG product: a Python/FastAPI backend embeds Abdur's real career data with sentence-transformers, retrieves the most relevant context per question, and an LLM (GPT-4o-mini) classifies intent and writes the reply, on a React/TypeScript frontend. Ask its chat assistant directly for the most current and detailed answers.

## Current Role

Full-Stack Python Developer at B1 Properties (Dubai, UAE), Jan 2025-Present: built a LangChain + RAG (ChromaDB) real estate chatbot, an AI Property Valuation System using GPT-4, an n8n GPT-4 reporting automation pipeline, and the production platform b1properties.ae.
